description:
### 3.11.0-enhanced.2-dev.13

* Fix undo trigger: restore no longer depends on ACTION_UP reaching the patched pointer hooks.
* Fix extra deletion: consume the first trailing stock Backspace after a successful undo.
* Self-repair fallback: if Gboard still removes one restored Unicode code point, repair that exact code point after state verification.
* Keep dev.12 safety: empty-field undo and same-editor validation remain enabled.
